notes: 8 configurations, 6 machines, 4 manufacturers (Bluefors Cryocooler Technologies/Cryomech, Stirling Cryogenics, THEVA, Micromeritics). Research constraint: the Tavily quota was exhausted and the shared WebSearch budget was used up when this task started, so machines were chosen from manufacturer sites reachable by direct WebFetch of known product URLs and their linked datasheets (PDFs read from the fetched copies). Categories covered: LN2-bath Ic measurement of HTS tape (TAPESTAR XL / XL-HF), SFCL / HTS-cable LN2 re-liquefaction and sub-cooling and 80 K zero-boil-off cooling (SPC-1, AL600), 20 K helium-loop and LH2 / hydrogen-liquefaction cooling (SPC-1T, AL630), hydrogen-sorption isotherms at 77 K and 25-350 K (3Flex). Not covered: LH2/LNG storage tanks (Cryofab CLH 100/250 LH2 container datasheets give net capacity 100/250 L, NER 2.0/1.6 %, MAWP 345 kPa (50 psi) but no storage temperature, so they were not used), cryogenic load frames, LNG flow-calibration rigs, variable-temperature high-field Ic facilities. Conventions: absences use install=not_available with value kind unknown (as in sibling industry files); bare cryocoolers document the cold-end interface diameter (AL600/AL630 127 mm) and sourced absences for sample height, vacuum, optics, wiring and magnet; cryogenerators without a sample interface (SPC-1, SPC-1T) record sample size as not_available. Conservative choices: AL600/AL630 values are for 60 Hz supply (50 Hz: 580 W at 80 K, 90 W at 20 K); AL600 temperature.range is 25-80 K and AL630 17-40 K because the published capacity data stop there (point requirements above those temperatures will read DOES_NOT_MEET although the coolers may physically run warmer). SPC-1 cooling power at 77/80 K and SPC-1T at 20 K are the lower ends of the printed ranges ('400 W to 2,7 kW at temperatures of 50-160 K', '50-175 W @ 20-60 K'), not curve readings. pressure.max_working for SPC-1/SPC-1T are gauge values (barg). TAPESTAR temperature 77 K: THEVA's product page states '@ 77 K' for the XL-HF; the XL/XL-HF datasheets say 'liquid nitrogen temperature' with LN2 at 0.05 MPa overpressure (the bath may be slightly above 77 K). 3Flex pressure.base is the lowest pressure of the specified analysis range (1e-6 Torr), not a stated ultimate vacuum. Accessed 2026-11-01.
